name: Battlemage
summary: A melee-arcane hybrid who builds momentum through physical combat to unleash devastating spells.
requirements: - Base Class: Warrior or Mage (Lv 10+) - Feats: Power Attack, Combat Casting, Arcane Momentum - Skills: Spellcraft, Concentration, Weapon Mastery - Alignment: Any non-Lawful Good
unlock: Slay a spellcasting foe with a melee strike while maintaining concentration on an active spell along Aethel's descent tiers — the Weave accepts hybrid battle-flow as Battlemage proof.
entrance: Slay a spellcasting foe with a melee strike while maintaining concentration on an active spell along Aethel's descent tiers — the Weave accepts hybrid battle-flow as Battlemage proof.
hallmarks: Battle Flow: Each melee hit along Aethel's descent tiers builds Momentum (max 5) — stacks persist through short rests until spent on Momentum Surge or lost on failed concentration.

Momentum Surge: Spend 1–5 Momentum to quick-cast or empower spellstrikes — each stack adds +tier floor force on the strike or reduces the spell action cost by one step (min bonus action); failed concentration clears unspent Momentum

Spellshock Guard: Gain magic resistance after casting in melee — after landing a spellstrike or casting within 5 ft of a foe, gain magic resistance equal to half your tier floor (min 2) until start of your next turn; stacks with Battle Flow Momentum spend

Arcane Grudge: Bonus damage vs enemy casters who injured you — when a spellcaster deals damage to you, gain Arcane Grudge until end of encounter; next melee hit against that caster deals +tier floor d6 force and ignores half their spell resistance
capstone: Draft — cash every Momentum stack into a close-range elemental surge, scattering foes from the line; the released battle-flow leaves recover Resonance Points equal to the cost of one Rank 3 spell when the air clears.
combatRole: Frontline disruptor and caster killer. Excels in hybrid burst pressure.

name: Beastmaster
summary: A primal commander who bonds with multiple beasts and leads them in coordinated battle.
requirements: - Base Class: Ranger or Druid (Lv 10+) - Feats: Companion Training, Survivalist, Beast Lore - Skills: Survival, Animal Empathy
unlock: During an Aethel wilderness trial along descent tiers, tame and command three CR-appropriate beasts without losing pack bond — primal command proves Beastmaster worth.
entrance: During an Aethel wilderness trial along descent tiers, tame and command three CR-appropriate beasts without losing pack bond — primal command proves Beastmaster worth.
hallmarks: Primal Pack: Bind up to three wild-tier beasts across Aethel's descent tiers — each companion scales with your level and fights as pack kin, not hired muscle.

Shared Instinct: Beast allies benefit from your feat bonuses — each bound companion inherits one combat feat you possess (Pack Tactics, Weapon Focus, or similar); when you command a companion, it gains advantage if you had advantage on your last attack that round

Pack Coordination: Issue a single command that steers the whole pack — bonus action directs up to three companions; commanded beasts move and attack on your initiative with shared Pack Tactics advantage when two or more target the same foe
capstone: Draft — once per long rest, call the full pack cadence: your bound pack acts twice each round and temporarily inherits your weapon feats. Across Aethel's wild tiers, Primal Pack kin move as extensions of your will until the command fades, their shared instinct carrying the scene rather than adding a new automated rule.
combatRole: Flexible frontline or skirmish leader. Best in mid-sized parties or wilderness zones.

name: Blademaster
summary: A weapon perfectionist who executes seamless, deadly strikes through honed martial flow.
requirements: - Base Class: Warrior or Thief (Lv 10+) - Feats: Weapon Focus, Weapon Mastery, Combat Reflexes - Skills: Acrobatics, Weapon Mastery
unlock: Best a named duelist in an Aethel trial ring without taking more than one hit — the Weave reads clean parry cadence as proof of Blademaster worth.
entrance: Best a named duelist in an Aethel trial ring without taking more than one hit — the Weave reads clean parry cadence as proof of Blademaster worth.
hallmarks: Blade Echo: Every third strike in a duelist's flow echoes into a free maneuver, as if the blade remembered the form before your hand did.

Parry Counter: On successful dodge or Parry against a melee attack, immediately retaliates with one weapon strike at advantage — third successful Parry in an encounter grants +1 to maneuver DC until end of turn

Precision Flow: Critical hits sharpen the duelist cadence — each crit increases maneuver DC by +2 and grants 50% chance to chain a free maneuver; third crit in an encounter resets one spent Parry Counter
capstone: Draft — for one round per short rest, Blade Echo perfects the duelist cadence: every exchange feels prefigured by the last, and all attacks auto-hit a foe already struck that turn; the third auto-hit grants a free Parry Counter before the form closes.
combatRole: Single-target DPS and duelist. Excels in agile combat and enemy pressure.

name: Bloodbound
summary: A vampiric predator who feeds on blood to empower attacks, summon thralls, and cheat death.
requirements: - Base Class: Crimson Agent or Thief (Lv 10+) - Feats: Hemocraft, Dark Affinity, Life Drinker - Skills: Stealth, Hemocraft, Arcana
unlock: Survive a vampiric infection from a Hollow Vale relic or story curse along Aethel's descent tiers and willingly accept the blood-oath — the Weave reads sanguine surrender as proof of Bloodbound worth.
entrance: Survive a vampiric infection from a Hollow Vale relic or story curse along Aethel's descent tiers and willingly accept the blood-oath — the Weave reads sanguine surrender as proof of Bloodbound worth.
hallmarks: Bloodletting Strikes: Draft — your wounds leave a crimson tally on prey; consume the bleed to turn their loss into relief or ruin.

Crimson Domination: Bend a humanoid will through blood-scent and vampiric presence — charm or dominate one target within 30 ft for tier floor rounds; thrall obeys simple commands and grants advantage on Intimidation vs. their allies until Domination ends
Sanguine Regeneration: Passive healing on kills and crits — regain HP equal to tier floor on kill; on crit, heal half damage dealt and refresh one Bloodletting Bleed stack on the target
Bloodwalk: Teleport to bleeding enemies in line of sight — arrive adjacent to a Bleeding target within 60 ft; your next melee hit consumes one Bleed stack to heal for the damage dealt

Mistform: Once per encounter, cheat death in crimson mist — when reduced to 0 HP, become incorporeal mist for 1 round, teleport up to 30 ft, and stabilize at 1 HP; leaving mist provokes opportunity attacks from foes who pierce illusion
capstone: Draft — take Master Vampire form for 1 minute: your bloodbound strikes lifesteal, Crimson Domination carries a fear aura, and resistance to nonmagical damage lets you hold the line while the hunger is awake.
combatRole: Sustained fighter with mobility and lifesteal. Dominates small skirmishes.

name: Berserker
summary: A chaos-fueled brute who thrives in the thick of battle, dealing AoE damage and overwhelming force.
requirements: - Base Class: Warrior or Shaman (Lv 10+) - Feats: Frenzied Rage, Endurance, Cleave - Skills: Athletics, Survival
unlock: Enter berserker Frenzy during a ritual combat trial along Aethel's descent tiers and slay ten foes solo — the Weave accepts only unbroken rage as proof of worth.
entrance: Enter berserker Frenzy during a ritual combat trial along Aethel's descent tiers and slay ten foes solo — the Weave accepts only unbroken rage as proof of worth.
hallmarks: Frenzy: Enter ritual combat rage along Aethel descent tiers — gain +tier floor melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, and immunity to Stagger while active; ends if you take a full rest action or fail a Deathlust round without a kill
Sweeping Blow: Your cleave carries ritual combat weight — arc through two adjacent foes in reach, knocking each back 10 ft and applying Stagger (−1 move) until Frenzy ends.
Deathlust: Each kill while Frenzy is active extends Frenzy by 1 round (max +3 rounds total); killing a boss-tier foe resets one spent Reckless Charge

Reckless Charge: Dash up to your speed through enemy spaces — each foe you pass through takes tier floor d6 bludgeoning and must save or be Dazed (−1 action) until end of your next turn; ends Frenzy early if you miss the charge line
capstone: Draft — while Frenzy rages along Aethel's descent tiers, the warbeat carries you past restraint: gain one extra action each round and immunity to fear or charm; killing a boss-tier foe during the capstone resets Frenzy duration once.
combatRole: AoE melee brute. Uncontrollable force of destruction in large skirmishes.

name: Chronomancer
summary: A manipulator of time who banks and reuses actions to twist turn order and tempo.
requirements: - Base Class: Mage or Arcanist (Lv 10+) - Feats: Arcane Calculus, Temporal Theory, Quickened Thought - Skills: Arcana, Knowledge: Planar
unlock: Solve the Paradox Puzzle in Aethel's Temporal Tower and bind your soul to its clockwork core — the Weave reads stolen beats as Chronomancer proof.
entrance: Solve the Paradox Puzzle in Aethel's Temporal Tower and bind your soul to its clockwork core — the Weave reads stolen beats as Chronomancer proof.
hallmarks: Delay Action: Bank unused actions in the Temporal Tower's clockwork cadence — spend stored beats later when the Weave's rhythm owes you a turn.
Rewind: Undo one missed action or reverse a failed save from the prior round — the Temporal Tower's clockwork cadence snaps back a beat; each use accrues 1 Fatigue until short rest (max 2)
Acceleration Field: Bonus action pulse in 15 ft radius — allies gain +10 ft movement and +2 initiative until start of your next turn; enemies leaving the zone save or lose one reaction until then
Time Rip: Age a target along Aethel's frayed timelines for 1 round — −2 AC and disadvantage on Dex saves; constructs and undead resist the aging but take force damage equal to your tier floor instead
capstone: Draft — unleash the banked beats in the Temporal Tower's clockwork core: take three full turns back-to-back (once/long rest). Allies within 15 ft gain +2 initiative for 1 round, then the stolen seconds settle on you as 2 Fatigue stacks; the clockwork afterimage is presentation only, not a new timing system.
combatRole: Tactical controller and initiative dominator. Can rewrite mistakes and seize tempo.

name: Echomancer
summary: A mystic who mirrors the powers of enemies and monsters, reshaping battle with reflected might.
requirements: - Base Class: Mage, Mirrorsage, or Arcanist (Lv 10+) - Feats: Spell Reflection, Mimicry, Arcane Adaptation - Skills: Arcana, Spellcraft
unlock: During an Aethel mirror-trial along descent tiers, absorb and reuse three distinct monster abilities in combat with a rare Mirror Crystal equipped — the Weave reads reflected might as proof of Echomancer worth.
entrance: During an Aethel mirror-trial along descent tiers, absorb and reuse three distinct monster abilities in combat with a rare Mirror Crystal equipped — the Weave reads reflected might as proof of Echomancer worth.
hallmarks: Mirror Pulse: Reflect a single-target spell back at the caster once per short rest — the echo retains the original tier and school, and you may redirect it to a second valid target within 30 ft
Echo Channel: After witnessing a monster or enemy cast, copy that ability for 2 rounds — uses your tier for potency; Mirror Crystal must be equipped; once per short rest per unique ability

Reflected Pain: When you take spell damage, the caster suffers psychic backlash equal to half damage taken (min tier floor); if Mirror Pulse is ready, backlash also applies to the original spell's school weakness
Reverb Core: Store one spell effect you cast (max tier = half your level) and release it on your next turn as a bonus action — stored effect uses original tier and ignores somatic components
capstone: Draft — for one minute, the Mirror Crystal opens into an echoing self: double your normal maximum Resonance Points for the duration, mimic up to two enemy spells each round, and release Mirror Pulse or a stored Reverb Core as an instant reflection.
combatRole: Spell disruptor and adaptive counter-caster. Highly effective vs enemy casters or bosses.

name: Forge Master
summary: A legendary blacksmith and combat engineer who imbues weapons and armor with mythic properties.
requirements: - Base Class: Tinker, Warrior, or Druid (Lv 10+) - Feats: Master Smithing, Hardened Grip, Core Infusion - Skills: Craft (Blacksmith), Engineering, Spellcraft
unlock: Forge a Tier IV relic weapon from your own recipe along Aethel's descent tiers and slay a named foe wielding only that steel — the Weave reads master-forged proof as Forge Master worth.
entrance: Forge a Tier IV relic weapon from your own recipe along Aethel's descent tiers and slay a named foe wielding only that steel — the Weave reads master-forged proof as Forge Master worth.
hallmarks: Relic Imbuement: Enhance crafted items with spell-like properties — imbue one weapon or armor piece per long rest with a 1st-tier spell rider; imbued gear retains the effect until destroyed or re-forged
Smith's Temper: Worn armor penalty reduced by 1 (min 0); equipped gear gains +2 max durability and ignores the first point of sunder or rust damage each encounter
Forge Focus: Once per long rest, 1-minute forge meditation restores all equipped gear to full durability and clears one minor curse or rust affliction from a single piece
Ember Pulse: Draft — a forge-bright edge kindles in the press of battle, leaving foes to face heat and hard-earned dread.
capstone: Draft — crafted gear no longer degrades beneath your hand; a relic weapon you forge wakes as a sentient adviser, offering warnings when a hidden threat, curse, or structural failure closes on the party.
combatRole: Support-tank and gear-enhancer. Strengthens the party by improving durability and arming allies with relic tools.

name: Giant Killer
summary: A specialized hunter trained to bring down colossal foes through precision, agility, and high-impact tactics.
requirements: - Base Class: Ranger, Soldier, or Warrior (Lv 10+) - Feats: Precision Strike, Anatomy Lore, Giant Slayer - Skills: Acrobatics, Survival, Knowledge (Monstrous Humanoids)
unlock: Solo a CR+3 Large or greater foe across Aethel's descent tiers using terrain hazards or a critical weak point — the Weave reads colossal hunter proof as Giant Killer worth.
entrance: Solo a CR+3 Large or greater foe across Aethel's descent tiers using terrain hazards or a critical weak point — the Weave reads colossal hunter proof as Giant Killer worth.
hallmarks: Kneecap Strike: Melee hits against Huge+ foes can cripple legs — on crit or when dealing ≥ half the target's max HP in one strike, reduce movement by 15 ft until end of your next turn; a second kneecap on the same target applies Prone
Scale the Beast: Climb onto Huge+ enemies as a bonus action to target weak zones — attacks from atop ignore half cover, gain +2 crit range, and Kneecap Strike applies on hit instead of crit only

Hunter’s Mark: Mark colossal prey across Aethel's descent tiers — bonus action to declare one Large+ foe; gain +2 crit range and +tier floor damage vs. the mark until it falls or you mark another (once/encounter)

Anchor Chain: Hurl a rune-harpoon to ground flying or leaping foes — ranged attack (30 ft) tethers one Large+ target; on hit, speed halved and flight suspended until they break the chain (Str save vs. tier DC) or you release it (bonus action)
capstone: Draft — once per day, name one Gargantuan creature as your slayer’s mark. For three rounds, every attack you land against that prey is a critical hit, turning its own impossible scale into the opening your hunt was made to find.
combatRole: Anti-boss duelist and elite bruiser. Built to turn colossal threats into wounded prey.

name: Gravetouched
summary: A cursed soul balanced between life and death, drawing necrotic power and resilience from undeath without fully surrendering.
requirements: - Base Class: Cleric, Warrior, or Crimson Agent (Lv 10+) - Feats: Necrotic Affinity, Undying Flesh, Dark Fortitude - Skills: Religion, Intimidation, Endurance
unlock: Fall to fatal necromancer curse along Aethel's descent tiers and rise unaided within one round — the Weave reads death-touched resilience as proof of Gravetouched worth.
entrance: Fall to fatal necromancer curse along Aethel's descent tiers and rise unaided within one round — the Weave reads death-touched resilience as proof of Gravetouched worth.
hallmarks: Undying Resilience: Gain resistance to necrotic and poison damage — when reduced to 0 HP by necrotic or poison, make a save at advantage to drop to 1 HP instead (once/long rest)
Bone Shield: Once per short rest, summon spectral bones to reduce incoming damage by half for 3 rounds — while active, Death Touch strikes apply Vulnerable to necrotic until the shield fades
Death Touch: Channel necrotic energy through melee strikes — on hit, deal extra necrotic equal to your tier floor and apply Wither (healing received halved) until end of your next turn
Grim Grasp: Enemies you kill cannot be revived, regenerated, or raised as undead for 24 hours — their corpse counts as desecrated ground; Bone Shield active extends this to allies' kills within 15 ft
capstone: Draft — when death takes hold, rise once per day at 1 HP wreathed in grave-cold resolve; for one minute, necrotic power hardens your strikes and a fear aura keeps the living at distance.
combatRole: Off-tank and bruiser with necrotic synergy. Self-reviving frontline disruptor.

name: Hexblade
summary: A weapon-bound curse channeler who weaves doom, fear, and arcane hexes through every strike.
requirements: - Base Class: Thief, Mage, or Crimson Agent (Lv 10+) - Feats: Curse Channeling, Dark Binding, Eldritch Combat - Skills: Arcana, Stealth, Intimidation
unlock: Voluntarily bind a cursed blade during a Hollow Vale blood rite along Aethel's descent tiers — the Weave reads willing doom-oaths as proof of Hexblade worth.
entrance: Voluntarily bind a cursed blade during a Hollow Vale blood rite along Aethel's descent tiers — the Weave reads willing doom-oaths as proof of Hexblade worth.
hallmarks: Hex Mark: Bound-weapon hits apply stacking Hex (max 3) — each stack adds tier floor necrotic on hit and −1 to the target's next save; at 3 stacks, removing Hex triggers capstone backlash

Eldritch Arc: Channel cantrips and 1st-tier hexes through bound-weapon strikes — melee hit delivers the spell without somatic components; once per short rest, a crit applies the hex rider at full tier
Doom Sigil: Draft — a ground-rune gathers dread beneath a chosen foe; when it wakes, the curse blooms into confusion and fear.
Blade Hunger: Draft — the bound blade remembers each victory, its appetite deepening until rest draws the edge quiet.
capstone: Draft — when a bound hex is broken, let its stored malice burst through a 15-foot radius; the backlash wounds nearby foes with necrotic force and leaves one curse clinging to the survivors.
combatRole: Mid-range threat. Sustained DPS, battlefield control, and psychological warfare.

name: Mooncursed
summary: A lycanthropic warrior whose form and powers vary by curse type — werewolf, werebear, or wererat — tied to alignment and base class.
requirements: - Base Class: Druid, Warrior, Thief, or Shaman (Lv 10+) - Feats: Primal Instinct, Cursebound Flesh, Blood Ritual - Skills: Survival, Athletics, Stealth (varies by form)
unlock: Endure a full lunar cycle with lycanthropy along Aethel's wild tiers and pass the Beast's Trial without succumbing — the Weave reads the moon's verdict as Mooncursed proof.
entrance: Endure a full lunar cycle with lycanthropy along Aethel's wild tiers and pass the Beast's Trial without succumbing — the Weave reads the moon's verdict as Mooncursed proof.
hallmarks: Lycan Form: Shift into your bound curse-shape for 60 seconds — werewolf, werebear, or wererat grants form-specific bonuses (+2 STR/DEX, pack tactics, or burrow); ending early via Curse Surge leaves one round of hybrid traits
Curse Surge: Spend HP to trigger special beast abilities — sacrifice up to 10 HP to activate your lycan form's bonus trait without transforming; at night, Curse Surge costs half HP
Lunar Tides: At night or during celestial events, Lycan Form duration doubles and Curse Surge costs no HP; during a full moon, Beast Within triggers at 35% HP instead of 25%

Beast Within: When HP drops below 25%, the lunar curse answers before thought — auto-transform for 60 seconds with lycan bonuses; choose form if multiple are unlocked, otherwise your bound curse form.
capstone: Draft — for one minute, take the full hybrid form with every unlocked lycan bonus, temporary flight, and damage immunity. The curse no longer pulls at the leash; beneath the moon, you are its fury made flesh.
combatRole: Versatile melee predator or tank. High mobility and shifting utility.

name: Sapper
summary: A demolition expert and trapmaster who controls the battlefield with explosives, snares, and mechanical warfare.
requirements: - Base Class: Tinker, Thief, or Soldier (Lv 10+) - Feats: Combat Engineering, Trapsetter, Siege Savant - Skills: Engineering, Disable Device, Craft (Explosives)
unlock: During an Aethel siege trial along descent tiers, fell a siege beast or construct with five or more trap types and no direct melee — the Weave reads field engineering as proof of Sapper worth.
entrance: During an Aethel siege trial along descent tiers, fell a siege beast or construct with five or more trap types and no direct melee — the Weave reads field engineering as proof of Sapper worth.
hallmarks: Tripwire Arsenal: Set mechanical traps with varied effects (stun, burn, slow) — deploy two tripwires per short rest; triggered traps apply their effect in 10 ft radius and grant one Demolition Pack charge (max 3)
Demolition Pack: Draft — planted charges turn breached cover and crowded lanes into controlled ruin.

Field Scanner: Gain vision of hidden traps, tunnels, or buried structures — bonus action pulse reveals traps and secret doors within 30 ft through walls up to 1 ft thick; marked hazards stay visible to allies for 1 minute

Saboteur’s Toolkit: Draft — each disabled mechanism leaves an opening for the crew to seize, its former certainty turned into a marked route, a broken guard, or a moment of cover before the next breach.
capstone: Draft — deploy three high-yield charges across one breach line, then detonate them together in a large radius; the blast breaks fragile terrain and leaves a burning demolition zone that harms foes for 1 minute.
combatRole: Area control and anti-fortification disruptor. Ideal in defensive sieges or narrow corridors.

name: Soulrender
summary: A necrotic engine of agony who harvests souls to power abilities, damage enemies, or shield allies.
requirements: - Base Class: Mage, Crimson Agent, or Cleric (Lv 10+) - Feats: Lifeleech, Soul Cage, Wounding Magic - Skills: Arcana, Religion, Intimidation
unlock: During a Hollow Vale soul-rite along Aethel's descent tiers, steal a living named foe's soul and bind it to a black crystal — the Weave reads harvested agony as proof of Soulrender worth.
entrance: During a Hollow Vale soul-rite along Aethel's descent tiers, steal a living named foe's soul and bind it to a black crystal — the Weave reads harvested agony as proof of Soulrender worth.
hallmarks: Soul Harvest: Absorb the soul of a dying foe within 30 ft to gain one soul charge (max = tier floor + 2); charges fuel Agony Lance and Spectral Ward without spending Resonance Points

Agony Lance: Fire a necrotic beam (60 ft) — initial hit plus Agony DoT for 2 rounds; target suffers −2 on Con/Wis saves while DoT persists; costs 1 soul charge or Resonance Points equal to the spell’s normal cost
Spectral Ward: Spend 1–2 soul charges to grant an ally temp HP equal to tier floor × charges spent, or redirect one incoming hit from an ally to yourself at half damage
Echo of Death: Draft — a soulbound foe’s last echo lingers at the edge of the black crystal, making recovery and return difficult while the scene remembers the voice that was taken from it.
capstone: Draft — unleash stored soul energy in a 30 ft aura, turning the gathered echoes into one grave-bright release. Enemies take massive damage, while allies are healed for half that amount as the departing voices shelter their own.
combatRole: Battlefield controller with lifesteal and team sustain. Rewards killing blows and positioning.

name: Storm Lord
summary: A tempest-fueled channeler of lightning, wind, and fury drawn directly from the Plane of Storms, Voltyros.
requirements: - Base Class: Shaman, Mage, or Druid (Lv 6+) - Feats: Stormcaller, Lightning Affinity, Voltyros Pact - Skills: Nature, Spellcraft, Endurance
unlock: Survive a direct Voltyros lightning strike atop the Spire of Storms along Aethel's tiers — awaken the storm-spark within as proof of Storm Lord worth.
entrance: Survive a direct Voltyros lightning strike atop the Spire of Storms along Aethel's tiers — awaken the storm-spark within as proof of Storm Lord worth.
hallmarks: Static Field: Create a 15 ft charged zone that shocks enemies at start of their turn (lightning damage = tier floor d6); Voltyros-aligned foes who enter save at disadvantage
Arc Surge: Cast chain lightning that arcs to additional targets within 15 ft — each jump adds +tier floor lightning damage; Voltyros-aligned foes hit twice count as two jumps for damage scaling

Stormstep: Bonus action dash up to 30 ft to a foe you can see — arrive in a thunder crack; enemies within 10 ft of your path take tier floor d6 lightning and save or are Dazed until end of your next turn
Eye of the Tempest: Draft — hold the storm's still center, where every breath gathers before the next thunder answers.
capstone: Draft — enter Voltyros stormform for 1 minute (once/long rest): flight 60 ft., lightning spells crit on 19–20, and a 10-ft shock aura deals tier floor d6 lightning at the start of enemy turns while the storm answers every motion.
combatRole: Mobile caster with heavy AoE and control. Strong zone dominance and mobility synergy.

name: Verdant Animist
summary: A summoner of living traps, stationary spirits, and wild overgrowth — master of battlefield flora.
requirements: - Base Class: Druid, Shaman, or Mage (Lv 4+) - Feats: Verdant Bond, Conjure Flora, Trapcasting - Skills: Nature, Spellcraft, Survival
unlock: During battle along Aethel's verdant tiers, infuse a Seed of the World Tree and slay three foes using only summoned flora — the Weave reads wild overgrowth as proof of Verdant Animist worth.
entrance: During battle along Aethel's verdant tiers, infuse a Seed of the World Tree and slay three foes using only summoned flora — the Weave reads wild overgrowth as proof of Verdant Animist worth.
hallmarks: Seedling Conjurations: Summon immobile plant creatures with specific attack patterns (thorns, spores, roots)
Living Terrain: Draft — roots and thorns redraw the ground, making every closing step feel watched by the wild.

Bloom Burst: Detonate active seedlings in a 15 ft burst — thorn-shrapnel and spore clouds linger one round, leaving difficult terrain that deals reactive damage to enemies who enter or start their turn there
Wild Synergy: Each active seedling conjuration adds +1 to your spell DC and conjuration damage (max +3); Bloom Burst radius expands 5 ft per active seedling when detonated
capstone: Draft — summon an enormous siege-flower for 60 seconds. Its lashing vines menace enemies, its roots poison the ground, and its living canopy shields allies within its radius while the battlefield remembers whose soil it is.
combatRole: Area denial and battlefield controller. Excels at map control and trap synergy.

name: Warlock
summary: A pact-bound caster who channels dark forces from beyond — void entities, old gods, or forbidden spirits.
requirements: - Base Class: Mage, Crimson Agent, or Shaman (Lv 3+) - Feats: Forbidden Pact, Eldritch Echo, Curse Weaving - Skills: Arcana, Occultism, Intimidation
unlock: Forge a soul pact with a beyond-plane entity along Aethel's outer thresholds and survive the Binding Trial with mind and body intact — the Weave reads eldritch debt as proof of Warlock worth.
entrance: Forge a soul pact with a beyond-plane entity along Aethel's outer thresholds and survive the Binding Trial with mind and body intact — the Weave reads eldritch debt as proof of Warlock worth.
hallmarks: Eldritch Blast: Core attack scaling with level and pact alignment — fires two beams at tier 10+; pact riders (hex, shadowstep mark) apply on either beam; beams may split targets within 30 ft
Pact Sigils: Draft — each pact mark is a borrowed signature, brightening whenever its old debt is called.

Soul Debt: Once per encounter, spend HP equal to Resonance Rank × 5 instead of paying that spell’s base RP cost — pact spells cost half that HP; dropping to 0 HP from Soul Debt triggers Curse Chain backlash on nearest foe
Curse Chain: Apply stacking pact debuffs that worsen each round — at 3 stacks the curse jumps to an adjacent foe within 15 ft at half potency; removing stacks triggers Soul Debt backlash
capstone: Draft — call your patron’s projection for one perilous minute, its presence lending pact-shaped spells and an aura that makes the bargain impossible for nearby foes to ignore.
combatRole: High damage, flexible casting with risky power mechanics. Specializes in single-target control and corruption.

name: Wyrmslayer
summary: A hunter forged in fire and scaled blood — the bane of dragons and their kin.
requirements: - Base Class: Warrior, Ranger, or Soldier (Lv 5+) - Feats: Favored Enemy (Dragon), Slayer’s Resolve, Cleave - Skills: Survival, Lore (Dragons), Weapon Mastery
unlock: Forge or modify your own wyrmslayer weapon, then slay a CR+3 dragon or greater wyrm across Aethel's descent tiers — scaled blood on personal steel proves the hunter's oath.
entrance: Forge or modify your own wyrmslayer weapon, then slay a CR+3 dragon or greater wyrm across Aethel's descent tiers — scaled blood on personal steel proves the hunter's oath.
hallmarks: Drakebane Arsenal: Personal weapons and forged wyrmslayer gear ignore dragon elemental resistances — on a crit vs. dragon-kin, strip one resistance category until end of your next turn

Scalebreaker Technique: Once per short rest, sunder draconic plating on strike — next hit against dragon or wyrm-kin ignores 4 AC and applies Vulnerable to your weapon damage type until end of your next turn; Drakebane crit extends the window one round

Fearless Roar: Answer draconic terror with defiance forged in scaled blood — immune to fear and frightful presence; allies within 15 ft gain advantage on saves vs. fear and resistance to psychic until start of your next turn when you roar (bonus action, once/encounter)

Draconic Lore Mastery: Read wyrm-lore at a glance — identify dragon age, breath type, and one hidden weakness as a free action; first attack each encounter against a newly identified dragon gains advantage and Drakebane Arsenal applies on a glancing hit
capstone: Draft — when you critically strike a dragon, choose one key ability—such as flight or breath—and disable it. A slain wyrm also yields bonus rare materials, proof that the hunter’s oath leaves nothing of scaled terror unclaimed.
combatRole: Anti-boss specialist. High durability and damage against elite targets, especially dragons.
